notes: Land cover is ESA WorldCover 2021, newer than the before image (2019): land already cleared or under construction can be mislabelled as cropland, so treat cropland as an upper bound
Buildings and road segments need OpenStreetMap, which was not reachable when this result was built: shown as unknown, not zero

sources: Copernicus Sentinel-2 L2A (ESA), via the Element84 Earth Search COG bucket
limits: Optical imagery cannot see through cloud; flagged areas with cloud are removed, not analysed.
Change type comes from spectral index rules (no training); check critical changes on the ground.
10 m pixels cannot resolve single small buildings or people.
Rivers, sandbars and lake edges move between dates and can be flagged as change; bare soil in dry regions can look like construction. Check flagged areas near water.

The learned model was trained on OSCD urban change (Sentinel-2, 2015 to 2018). On farmland with no real construction it can raise many more false alarms than the spectral rules; check results on the ground.
